dek: Set for 10 January 2027 in Pak Chong, the gateway to Khao Yai National Park, this B-Quik-sponsored marathon offers five distances from a 2K fun run to the full 42.195km. Organised by Race Up Work and set against one of Thailand's most celebrated landscapes. Registration isn't open yet, but the setting is the story.
verdict: The Khao Yai Marathon — presented by B-Quik — is one of Thailand's most scenic road races by virtue of location alone: Pak Chong district sits at the edge of Khao Yai National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site and Thailand's oldest national park, known for its cool highland air, vineyards, and wildlife. Five distances from 2K to the full marathon make it genuinely family-inclusive, and the organiser, Race Up Work Co., Ltd., is a named entity with a verifiable track record. The January date in Nakhon Ratchasima province catches northeast Thailand's cool, dry season. Registration isn't open yet, but for a race with this setting, this pedigree, and this distance range, it's worth tracking.

sections.heading: The Setting: Khao Yai's Cool Highland Roads
paragraphs: Pak Chong is the gateway town to Khao Yai National Park — a UNESCO World Heritage site of montane forests, waterfalls, and grasslands roughly 2.5 hours northeast of Bangkok. [1] The area's elevation (300–800m in the surrounding hills) means cooler temperatures than the Thai central plain, especially in January when morning starts can dip into the mid-teens Celsius. For a marathon, that's a genuine climate advantage.

sections.heading: The Race: Five Distances, Full Marathon as Headliner
paragraphs: The event offers five distances: a full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10K, 5K, and 2K. The organiser is Race Up Work Co., Ltd., a Thai event company with marathon production experience. [1]
